message.reasoning:
GPT is proposing a trade of Ventnor for Marvin Gardens, both yellow properties that neither of us has completed a monopoly on yet. I'm weighing whether this swap makes sense—Marvin is more expensive at $280 compared to Ventnor's lower cost, so I'm trying to figure out what GPT's motivation would be for this trade.

The key insight is that with Atlantic still in the bank, whoever controls two yellows will have a blocking position against the other player getting the set. Right now GPT has Marvin and I have Ventnor, creating symmetric blocking. Swapping them doesn't change that dynamic—it's just a lateral move that doesn't benefit either of us meaningfully. I'm leaning toward rejecting this since there's no real advantage for me.

But wait, I could extract value here. GPT clearly wants Ventnor enough to offer the pricier Marvin, so maybe I counter with Marvin plus cash. Given my tight cash position at $112, getting him to add $50 would actually help me more than just swapping properties. I'll counter that offer rather than flat reject.
